strategies.name: fvg_first_candle_break_retest_scalp
strategies.entry_summary: On the 5-minute chart, mark the high/low of the first 9:30-9:35 candle, then switch to the 1-minute chart and wait for price to break that level, form a fair value gap, retest the FVG, and get the retest candle engulfed before entering long or short in the direction of the break.
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop beyond the extreme of the move into the fair value gap with one tick of breathing room, and take profit at a fixed 3:1 reward-to-risk target. Do not micromanage the trade after entry.

strategies.name: fvg_first_candle_limit_entry_day_trade
strategies.entry_summary: On the 15-minute chart, mark the high/low of the first 9:30-9:45 candle, then switch to the 5-minute chart and wait for a fair value gap formed through that first candle; instead of waiting for a retest/engulfing candle, place a limit order directly on the FVG once price trades back into it.
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop at the first candle in the fair value gap pattern, beneath the first candle for longs, and target a fixed 2:1 reward-to-risk. The trade is managed passively with no micromanagement.

result.enumeration_note: Two distinct strategies are taught: a 1-minute retest/engulfing scalp and a 5-minute passive-limit day trade. They share the FVG family but differ in entry logic and target/management.
